run_episode_generator: run the rearrange episode generator with a config file to generate episodes and save to JSON
list_scenedataset_metadata: list available scenes, objects, and receptacles from the configured SceneDataset to console
get_config_defaults: get the default RearrangeEpisodeGeneratorConfig with all sampler and resource set definitions
print_metadata_mediator: print a summary of scenes, rigid objects, articulated objects, and receptacles from the SceneDataset
get_arg_parser: get the argparse parser with config, output, run, list, debug, and episode count arguments
